EN:
{{TAG:0003:0020:}}Wow, I haven't seen you in a long
time, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}If you're popping up in my dreams,
you MUST have made a huge
splash in my life, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0020:}}¡Cuánto tiempo, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Si apareces en mis sueños, seguro
que me causaste buena impresión
en la realidad, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0020:}}Waouh, ça fait une éternité,
{{TAG:0005:0008:}}.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Tu rêvais de me revoir, avoue. Eh
bien, ton rêve se réalise. Merci qui,
{{TAG:0005:0007:}} ?
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0020:}}Però! È da un po' che non ti si
vede in giro, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}. {{TAG:0003:0001:}}Ti dirò,
ultimamente ti ho sognat{{TAG:000E:0006:02006F0002006100}} spesso.
Devi essermi rimast{{TAG:000E:0006:02006F0002006100}} impress{{TAG:000E:0006:02006F0002006100}}.

{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0020:}}Wow, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}! {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Dich hab ich ja
schon lange nicht mehr gesehen,
{{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Du musst ganz schön Eindruck bei
mir hinterlassen haben, wenn du hier
in meinen Träumen auftauchst.
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0020:}}Vay, seni uzun zamandır görmüyordum,
{{TAG:0005:0008:}}.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Rüyalarıma bile giriyorsan
hayatımda epey
iz bırakmış olmalısın, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.

DE:
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}Bist du das, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}?
{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Seltsam, wem man alles in seinen
Träumen begegnet, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}Gerçekten sen misin, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Rüyalarda insanın yeniden kimlerle
karşılaşacağı hiç
belli olmuyor, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Well, I guess that settles it,
{{TAG:0005:0007:}}. {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}This must be a dream
if I'm seeing you again, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}.
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Sí, no puede tener otra explicación,
{{TAG:0005:0007:}}. {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}Si te veo es porque
estoy soñando, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Désolé, {{TAG:0005:0008:}} : j'ai l'air aussi 
beau que dans la réalité, mais c'est
juste un rêve, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}. {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}Non ?
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0011:}}Che ci fai qui, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}?{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} {{TAG:0003:0015:}}{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}Non mi
sarei mai aspettato di rivederti...
Forse sto sognando. {{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Pekâlâ, mesele çözüldü demek,
{{TAG:0005:0007:}}. {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}Seni yeniden gördüğüme göre
bu kesinlikle
bir rüya, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}.

IT:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Ehi, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}. {{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}Non so dove siamo{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}},
ma sono contento che tu sia qui. {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}
Non pensavo che ti avrei rivisto...
Sogno o son desto, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}?
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Hey, {{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}seni burada görmek güzel, {{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}burası her

bir daha göreceğimi hiç
sanmıyordum, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.

ES:
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}¡¿Cómo?! {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0028:}}¡No puede ser! {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}¿Eres tú,
{{TAG:0005:0008:}}?{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} Sabía que volveríamos
a encontrarnos.
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Y aquí estás, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}
Aunque "aquí" es un sitio
indeterminado en mi mente.
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}Cosa?! {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0028:}}Non ci credo! {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Sei tu,
{{TAG:0005:0008:}}?{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} Lo sapevo che prima
o poi ci saremo rivisti.
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}E ora eccoti qua, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}
Però mi chiedo solo dove siamo...
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}Was?!? {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0028:}}Unmöglich! {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Bist du das,
{{TAG:0005:0008:}}? {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Ich wusste, dass wir
uns irgendwo wiedersehen würden.
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Und jetzt treffen wir uns hier an
diesem Ort, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}. {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0017:}}Wo sind
wir hier überhaupt?
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}Ne?! {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0028:}}Yok artık! {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Sen misin,
{{TAG:0005:0008:}}?{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} {{TAG:0003:0026:}}Bir şekilde tekrar

{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Ve işte buradasın, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}
